method: five-module online model: data features -> ExtraTrees demand/dwell + weekday-hour arrivals -> physics world model -> counterfactual capacity rollout -> EDF charging decision
assumptions: charger limit is known at arrival
demand and dwell are unchanged by the capacity intervention
future arrivals are modeled from public history, not known in advance
limitations: arrival features cannot capture all driver intent
rollout does not model battery taper
counterfactual response is model-internal physics, not real behavioral causal evidence
